title: Buyer Portal Selection Limits for Design Studio Selections Packages
content:
Finish options on a Design Studio Selections file may be selected through the buyer portal only on the packages that permit it, and only up to the package's portal selection cap: the largest option total, in US dollars, of finish lines that may be selected through the buyer portal on one file.

| Package | Finish options may be selected through the buyer portal | Portal selection cap per file (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | Yes | 5000.00 |
| Studio Classic | Yes | 7500.00 |
| Studio Select | Yes | 10000.00 |
| Studio Designer | No | 0.00 |
| Studio Signature | No | 0.00 |
| Studio Atelier | No | 0.00 |

**Points read from the table**

- Portal selection is open on Studio Essentials, Studio Classic and Studio Select, and closed on Studio Designer, Studio Signature and Studio Atelier, whose cap is 0.00.
- The cap applies to the portal total of the file: the finish lines selected through the portal less the removal credits of those lines.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Studio Classic file whose portal total stands at 6000.00 has 1500.00 of portal room left under its 7500.00 cap.
